# Resource: stripe_radar_value_list_item

A value in a Radar value list. `terraform destroy` deletes the item.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_radar_value_list" "blocked_emails" {
  alias     = "blocked_emails"
  name      = "Blocked email addresses"
  item_type = "email"
}

resource "stripe_radar_value_list_item" "spammer" {
  value_list = stripe_radar_value_list.blocked_emails.id
  value      = "spammer@example.com"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `value` - (Required) The value of the item (whose type must match the type of the parent value list). Changing it replaces the resource.
* `value_list` - (Required) The identifier of the value list which the created item will be added to. Changing it replaces the resource.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `created_by` - The name or email address of the user who added this item to the value list.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a radar value list item using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_radar_value_list_item.spammer
  id = "rsli_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_radar_value_list_item.spammer
  identity = {
    id = "rsli_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the radar value list item.

Using `terraform import`, import a radar value list item using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_radar_value_list_item.spammer rsli_123
```
